$comment: NAVIER-AM built-in material library. Every entry carries its status and provenance. Status 'demonstration' means literature-typical magnitudes assembled so that workflows can run end to end; such values are NOT traceable to a specific grade, supplier, test method or dataset, are NOT calibrated, and must be replaced with measured data (tensile tests, DMA, dilatometry, DSC, laser flash, high-temperature tensile tests) before results are used quantitatively. Tables list temperatures in degC and values in the SI unit named by the key; values are interpolated linearly and held constant outside the table. Thermal expansion is the instantaneous (tangent) coefficient; the solver integrates it from the stress-free reference temperature.
